ATK Phantom

The ATK Phantom has an excellent shape that's slightly wider and shorter than the ULX Medium, light and crispy OMRON optical clicks, a grippy coating, and solid wireless performance. There's some flex near the main buttons, and the scroll wheel could use more grip, but neither affected my gameplay. After 12 days of CS2, this mouse is staying in my rotation.

My testing notes, the full video, what comes in the box, and whether I’d buy it.
